subtitle: You open their account; they sign in with a user ID and password.
addHint: Their phone gets a user ID and a starting password.
name: Name
userIdRules: 4–20 lowercase English letters, digits or _. They sign in with it.
STAFFHint: Orders, stock and customers. Doesn't see costs.
MANAGERHint: Also products, prices, the team and settings.
sentNone: SMS and email aren't set up yet; hand it over yourself.
onceOnly: This password won't be shown again.
onceOnlyHint: They set their own the first time they sign in. If they don't within 7 days it stops working; then send a new one.
existing: This phone or email already has a Mojud account. They sign in with their own user ID and password and will see this business too.
existingNote: The user ID you typed wasn't needed, and no new password was made.
toldNone: SMS and email aren't set up yet; let them know yourself.
freeHint: Change plan to add staff or managers: up to 10 on Starter, any number on Pro.
fullHint: Removing someone frees a seat. For more people, take Pro.
passwordPoints: Their current password stops working|A new starting password goes by SMS, and shows here once|They set their own again when they sign in
matrixHint: Only the owner can change these rules.
matrixNote: Changes apply at once to all staff or all managers. The owner's column and owner-only tasks can't be changed.
